item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C2: The 2026-09-29 entry for this record said the Brookfield…
item.description: The 2026-09-29 entry for this record said the Brookfield construction halt could only be dated to 2022. That left out what Bisnow reports: its October 20, 2022 article says 'progress stalled in April', after 'a work stoppage earlier this year', so the halt is dated April 2022 (the year follows from 'earlier this year' in an October 2022 article). Bisnow is describing the 28-acre Pier 70 project's first phase as a whole, not this parcel in particular. The Real Deal's April 17, 2023 article says only that the developer halted construction 'last year'. The milestone stays marked approximate. Source: Bisnow, 2022-10-20 (https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/mixed-use/brookfield-properties-and-port-of-san-francisco-inch-closer-to-pier-70-completion-115959); The Real Deal, 2023-04-17 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2023/04/17/brookfield-leases-first-seven-tenants-at-pier-70/).

item.description: The Port report says Phase 1 streets and utilities are complete but the Phase 1 parks are still to be built, and the housing description now matches the developer's page (at least 100 households, size estimated). Source: Chinatown Community Development Center, In Development (https://www.chinatowncdc.org/our-housing/in-development); Port of San Francisco, Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline); Bisnow, 2022-10-20 (https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/mixed-use/brookfield-properties-and-port-of-san-francisco-inch-closer-to-pier-70-completion-115959).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Parcel C2 showed 2042 as an expected completion
item.description: Parcel C2 showed 2042 as an expected completion. That year is the original deadline for the whole project's last phase, not a forecast for C2, so it was removed. item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C2: The Phase 1 schedule is described as tolled by the down market…
item.description: The Phase 1 schedule is described as tolled by the down market delay (extended to December 26, 2026, Port Item 11A) rather than lapsed, with the 2042 whole-project date kept as a soft date that is not a forecast for this parcel. The map notes no longer say the block has no Assessor lot or that the D4D height figure shows a Residential fill; Residential use is cited to D4D Figure 2.1.1 (which also allows a garage) and the 100% affordable C2A status to Port Resolution 20-07. The Chinatown CDC page is described as not naming a parcel; 'since 2022' was dropped from the Port's statement; the Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022 rather than April 2022; the Board of Supervisors vote on the Development Agreement shows first reading Oct 31 and final passage Nov 14, 2017; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12B and Resolution 20-07, 2020-02-11 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2012B%20Pier%2070%20Parcels%20E2%20and%20A.pdf); San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Ordinance No. 224-17 (https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff… (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port staff report for the Commission's Aug 11, 2026… (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report for the Commission's Aug 11, 2026 meeting (dated Aug 7) says the C2A affordable project 'has not advanced' for lack of gap funding; proposed amendments would require the developer to close escrow on C2B (with A and D) by 2029-2030 or face a public offering (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port Commission: Port staff and the… (late 2026 or early 2027)
item.description: Port Commission: Port staff and the developer are drafting amendments to the DDA and related transaction documents "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year" (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.2 and p.6). Port Commission minutes of Aug 11, 2026 (p.7): staff and Brookfield "expect to return with proposed amendments in late 2026 or early 2027". The source gives no hearing date. The date shown is the early end of that window (December 2026); "early next year" falls in 2027. The same report proposes extending the term of the DDA, Development Agreement and Master Lease by 5 years. (late 2026 or early 2027). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port reports (Aug 7, 2026 staff report, p.1) that its… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port reports (Aug 7, 2026 staff report, p.1) that its developer 'has successfully completed Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and the rehabilitation of historic Building 12', while 'construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases (from just under 5% to a peak of 36%), a 20-30% escalation in construction costs and higher interest rates; the report adds (p.3) that the balance of the Phase 1 horizontal improvements, largely the Phase 1 parks and open space, 'will be constructed on a schedule that coincides with the delivery of adjacent vertical development' (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Then the Board of Supervisors: the same amendments are… (~Dec 2026)
item.description: Then the Board of Supervisors: the same amendments are to go to the Board of Supervisors in the same window (Item 11A, p.6: "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year"). The source gives no separate date or order for the Board. The date shown is the early end of the window; "early next year" falls in 2027. (~Dec 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C2: The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls the… (Dec 26, 2026)
item.description: The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls the developer's time-sensitive DDA obligations including close of escrow on option parcels, is extended to December 26, 2026: it reached its 60-month maximum in June 2026 and the parties agreed to extend it six months to allow time to complete the DDA amendments (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.4: "the parties mutually agreed to extend the down market delay for an additional six months to December 26, 2026"). This is the end date of an extension the parties agreed under the DDA; the report does not call it a deadline, and it is not a forecast. (Dec 26, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Phase 1 down market delay reaches its 60-month maximum (~Jun 2026)
item.description: Phase 1 down market delay reaches its 60-month maximum; the parties extend it by six months to December 26, 2026 while DDA amendments are drafted (~Jun 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.description: Phase 1 streets and utilities accepted by the City and Port; streets around Pier 70 opened to the public in May 2024 (~2024). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Work on the 28-acre project stalls after the Phase 1… (~Apr 2022)

Source: Bisnow (Joseph Gordon), 2022-10-20; The Real Deal (citing SF Business Times), 2023-04-17; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.description: Final appraisal of Parcel E2 comes in below its DDA threshold value, triggering a Phase 1 'down market delay' that tolls the developer's deadlines to close on option parcels (~Jun 2021). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Phase 1 site preparation and demolition begin (~Aug 2018)
item.description: Phase 1 site preparation and demolition begin; utility and street construction on 20th, Maryland, Louisiana, 21st and 22nd Streets follows in March 2019 (~Aug 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
